HintText: Every great factory begins with a Primitive Home. This is where your villagers will be born.
CelebrationMessage: Your Primitive Home is placed! Villagers will spawn here.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Primitive Home by selecting the Spawner icon on the hotbar, then click on a tile on the map.

HintText: Villagers need a way out! Place an exit gate so they can leave the Primitive Home.
CelebrationMessage: Exit placed! Villagers will leave the Primitive Home onto the path.

Conditions.StepMessage: Select the PathGate tool. Place it adjacent to the Primitive Home, facing away from it. That makes it an Exit — villagers leave the building onto the path.

HintText: Your villager needs a job! Place a Forestry gathering spot on a forest tile.
CelebrationMessage: Forestry placed! Now villagers can gather wood.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Forestry gathering spot on a forest biome tile. The highlighted tiles show valid forest locations.

HintText: Villagers need a way in! Place an entrance gate on the Forestry so they can enter.
CelebrationMessage: Entrance placed! Villagers walking past will turn in to gather.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a PathGate facing toward the Forestry to create an Entrance. Villagers walking along the path will turn off and enter the building.

HintText: Draw a path from the Primitive Home exit to the Forestry entrance so your villager can reach the gathering spot.
CelebrationMessage: Path connected! Your villager can now reach the Forestry.

Conditions.StepMessage: Select the Path tool from the hotbar, then draw a path connecting the exit gate to the Forestry entrance gate.

HintText: Your villager will spawn, walk along the path, and enter the Forestry. With bare hands, he can only pick up sticks!
CelebrationMessage: He's gathering sticks! With no tool equipped, bare hands can only collect sticks. An axe would let him collect logs!

Conditions.StepMessage: Watch the villager gather. With bare hands he can only pick up sticks. If he had an axe, he could collect logs!

HintText: The villager is carrying sticks but has nowhere to drop them off. Place a Stockpile!
CelebrationMessage: Stockpile placed! Villagers can drop off and pick up resources here.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Stockpile nearby. This will be the drop-off point for gathered resources.

HintText: Your Stockpile accepts everything by default. Open the Stockpile Inspector and use the Product Picker to select 'sticks' so only sticks are stored here.
CelebrationMessage: Stockpile filter set! Now only sticks will be accepted. This keeps your storage organized.

Conditions.StepMessage: Click on the Stockpile to open the Inspector, then press the '+ Add Item Filter' button and select 'sticks' from the Product Picker.

HintText: Place an entrance gate on the Stockpile so villagers carrying items can enter and drop them off.
CelebrationMessage: Entrance gate on Stockpile placed!

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a PathGate facing toward the Stockpile to create an Entrance.

HintText: The villager needs a way out of the Forestry! Place an exit gate so he can leave after gathering.
CelebrationMessage: Exit gate on Forestry placed! The villager can now leave with his sticks.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a PathGate facing away from the Forestry to create an Exit. Villagers will leave the building onto the path.

HintText: Draw a path from the Forestry exit to the Stockpile entrance so villagers can deliver their sticks.
CelebrationMessage: Path connected! The drop-off route is ready.

Conditions.StepMessage: Draw a path from the Forestry exit gate to the Stockpile entrance gate.

HintText: Watch the villager leave the Forestry carrying sticks and drop them off at the Stockpile.
CelebrationMessage: The villager dropped off sticks at the Stockpile! Your first delivery route is working!

Conditions.StepMessage: Watch the villager exit the Forestry, walk to the Stockpile, and drop off the sticks.

HintText: The villager dropped off his sticks but is stuck in the Stockpile. Place an exit gate so he can leave!
CelebrationMessage: Stockpile exit placed!

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a PathGate facing away from the Stockpile to create an Exit.

HintText: Draw a loop path from the Stockpile exit back toward the Forestry entrance. This creates a repeating production loop!
CelebrationMessage: Your first production loop is complete! The villager will gather, drop off, and repeat. But he's getting tired...

Conditions.StepMessage: Draw a path from the Stockpile exit back toward the Forestry entrance to create a loop. Careful with routing — if you lead back to the wrong entrance, villagers get stuck!

HintText: Workers get exhausted! Place a Resting Spot (Inn) so your villager can recover stamina. The Inn won't accept villagers carrying goods — they must drop off first!
CelebrationMessage: Resting Spot is ready! Your villager will rest here after dropping off sticks.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Resting Spot (Inn). Workers need rest after gathering!
Place a PathGate facing toward the Inn to create an Entrance. Remember: the Inn rejects villagers carrying items!
Place a PathGate facing away from the Inn to create an Exit. Rested villagers will leave and continue the loop.

HintText: Watch the full production loop in action: gather sticks → drop off at Stockpile → rest at the Inn → repeat!
CelebrationMessage: Phase 1 Complete! Your production loop is fully operational! The villager gathers, delivers, rests, and repeats. You've mastered the basics of factory building. Next up: stone gathering, crafting, and class training!

Conditions.StepMessage: Watch your villager loop: gather sticks at the Forestry, drop them off at the Stockpile, rest at the Inn, and repeat until you have at least 20 sticks in the Stockpile!
Conditions.CompletionMessage: Phase 1 Complete! Your factory is alive!

HintText: Your stockpile is full of sticks! Build a Craft Station to turn them into useful equipment.
CelebrationMessage: Craft Station placed! Now you can craft equipment from raw materials.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Craft Station from the hotbar. This building turns raw materials into weapons and tools!

HintText: The Craft Station needs an entrance for deliveries and an exit for finished villagers.
CelebrationMessage: Craft Station is connected! Villagers can now deliver materials and leave after crafting.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a PathGate facing toward the Craft Station to create an Entrance. Villagers carrying sticks will walk in and drop them off.
Place a PathGate facing away from the Craft Station to create an Exit.

HintText: Open the Craft Station inspector and select the Wooden Spear recipe.
CelebrationMessage: Recipe selected! The Craft Station will now produce Wooden Spears from sticks.

Conditions.StepMessage: Click the Craft Station to open its inspector, then use the 'Select Recipe' button to choose the Wooden Spear recipe (4 sticks → 1 Wooden Spear).

HintText: One villager isn't enough! Place a second spawner to double your workforce.
CelebrationMessage: Second spawner placed! More villagers means faster production.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a second Spawner from the hotbar. You'll need more workers for your growing factory!
Place an Exit on the new spawner so villagers can leave.
Connect the new spawner's exit to your existing path network.

HintText: You need to route villagers carrying sticks to the Craft Station. A Filter Splitter can do that!
CelebrationMessage: Filter Splitter placed! Now configure it to route stick-carrying villagers.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Filter Splitter from the hotbar. It routes villagers based on what they're carrying.

HintText: Set the Filter Splitter to route villagers carrying sticks toward the Craft Station.
CelebrationMessage: Filter configured! Villagers carrying sticks will now be routed to the Craft Station.

Conditions.StepMessage: Click the Filter Splitter to open its inspector, then set the item filter to 'sticks'. Villagers carrying sticks will be routed to the filtered output direction.

HintText: Draw paths from the Filter Splitter's filtered output to the Craft Station entrance.
CelebrationMessage: Paths connected! Stick-carrying villagers will now reach the Craft Station.

Conditions.StepMessage: Draw a path from the Filter Splitter's filtered output to the Craft Station entrance.

HintText: Villagers carrying sticks will enter the Craft Station, deposit their materials, and if enough sticks are available, the villager will stay and craft a Wooden Spear. They'll leave carrying the finished weapon!
CelebrationMessage: A Wooden Spear has been crafted! Your factory is now producing equipment!

Conditions.StepMessage: Villagers carrying sticks will enter the Craft Station and deposit their materials. Once 4 sticks have been deposited, the next villager to enter will stay and craft a Wooden Spear — then leave carrying it!

HintText: Untrained villagers can't enter dungeons. Build a Warrior School to train them!
CelebrationMessage: Warrior School placed! Connect it to your path network.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Training Building (Warrior School) from the hotbar. Villagers who enter will be trained as Warriors.

HintText: Connect the Warrior School with entrance, exit, and paths so villagers can flow through.
CelebrationMessage: Warrior School is connected! Villagers will now walk in for training.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place an Entrance on the Warrior School so untrained villagers can enter.
Place an Exit on the Warrior School so trained Warriors can leave.
Connect the Warrior School to your path network.

HintText: An untrained villager will enter the Warrior School. Watch them emerge as a Warrior!
CelebrationMessage: Your first Warrior! Trained villagers can now enter dungeons — but it's dangerous without gear!

Conditions.StepMessage: Watch a villager enter the Warrior School and complete training. They'll emerge as a Warrior — ready for adventure!

HintText: Place a Dungeon Portal and connect it. Warriors can enter — but only ~10% survive! Even fewer without gear.
CelebrationMessage: Dungeon Portal placed and connected! Route your Warriors to it.

Conditions.StepMessage: Place a Dungeon Portal from the hotbar. This is where your Warriors will face deadly challenges!
Place an Entrance so Warriors can enter the portal.
Place an Exit. Survivors will emerge here — if any survive.
Connect the Dungeon Portal to your path network.

HintText: Route a Warrior to the Dungeon Portal. ~90% of adventurers don't survive — even fewer without a weapon! But survivors level up and unlock tier 2 progression.
CelebrationMessage: Phase 2 Complete! Your first adventurer entered the dungeon! Warriors with weapons have much better chances. Survivors become Level 2 and unlock higher-tier equipment, resources, and dungeons. Keep building!

Conditions.StepMessage: Route a trained Warrior to the Dungeon Portal. It's lemmings-esque — very few survive, but survivors level up! Tip: Warriors with a Wooden Spear have 4× better survival odds.
Conditions.CompletionMessage: A Warrior entered the dungeon! Phase 2 complete!
